name: Ayu International Diesel Index
usMethod: mean of NYH and USGC log returns of arithmetic weekday means; at least two actual observations in a completed week
euMethod: median matched-country log return, fixed EU27 sampling frame excluding UK and official weighted aggregates
euAvailableAt: following Friday 00:00 Europe/Brussels (11 days after survey Monday), conservative schedule bound; not an observed vintage timestamp
euRevisionAdmission: official country series; compare 6 historical weekly releases; median protects isolated correction; no claim of universal vintage equivalence
usAvailableAt: day after actual ALFRED realtime_start_date 00:00 America/Chicago
label: next observation week's AIDI log return; may mature after the horizon ends; labelKnownAt must precede the next fitting block
thresholdRule: minimum joint validation Brier/log-loss ratio to frequency among candidates with each train and validation class >=15%, no class >60%; tie lower threshold
calibration: preceding calendar year; expanding training earlier; purge by labelKnownAt at both block boundaries
selection: validation mean normalized Brier and log-loss; same independent rule for US-only and EU-only routes; no Test or Japan selection
continuousDistribution: honest last 52 mature training weeks residuals from a preceding training fit; refit on mature train; Jeffreys smoothing in residual empirical CDF
featureControl: 38 predeclared features: 13 own-index, 5 regional divergence, 12 crude, 2 return-spread proxies, 4 EIA changes, 2 seasonal; no automatic feature selection; regularization and depth/leaf limits; regional routes retain identical non-diesel context

gate.properScores: strictly lower Brier and log-loss than best simple baseline, separately
gate.calibration: top-label ECE <=0.10 and each class ECE <=0.10
gate.years: strict majority of full test years no worse on both proper scores versus pooled best simple baseline
gate.collapse: each class predicted at least 5%, each recall >=10%
gate.sixtyBucket: each class n>=30 in [55%,65%], realized rate within 10 percentage points of mean forecast; otherwise insufficient evidence
gate.composite: beats both independently validation-selected regional routes on both pooled proper scores and a strict majority of full years
gate.asia: actual independent Japanese weekly data; correlation, direction and lag evidence without tuning; missing evidence cannot pass

currentState: median of trailing 1/4/13-week empirical percentiles against strictly preceding expanding history; <1/3 WEAK, >2/3 STRONG, otherwise NEUTRAL; descriptive, not a probability
binary: same frozen feature/model/calibration selection protocol; exclude future FLAT only for retrospective diagnosis; not a deployable FLAT filter
